prompt: Create an ultra-realistic, high-end lifestyle portrait of an adult Black man seated confidently in a luxurious modern interior, photographed in a sophisticated editorial fashion style. The subject sits in a wide, relaxed pose in a black leather lounge chair with black-and-white houndstooth upholstery, looking down at a silver wristwatch on his left wrist while holding a smartphone in his right hand. He wears an all-black traditional long-sleeve tunic and matching trousers, a structured black cap, thin clear eyeglasses, a ring, a silver metal watch, and brown crossed-strap leather sandals. Use warm indoor ambient lighting with soft highlights and natural skin texture, crisp focus on the subject, shallow but readable background depth, and premium magazine editorial realism. The setting is a luxury hotel lobby or upscale lounge with polished beige marble floors, beige marble wall panels, a tall indoor palm tree wrapped in warm fairy lights behind him, dark vertical wooden slat wall panels on the right, and one round white ribbed side table with gold trim at the right edge. Compose as a vertical 3:4 full-body seated portrait, camera slightly below eye level, subject centered slightly left, feet visible in the foreground, elegant reflections on the floor, rich black and warm gold color palette, no text, no watermark, no extra people, no distorted hands or accessories.

promptZh: 创作一张超写实的高端生活方式肖像，主角为 一位年轻的黑人男性，自信地坐在一处奢华的现代室内空间中，采用精致的时尚杂志风格进行拍摄。主体位于全景垂直构图的中心，放松地坐在配有黑白千鸟格软垫的黑色真皮休闲椅上。他身穿 一套全黑传统长袖束腰外衣及配套长裤，并佩戴黑色帽子，戴着透明细框眼镜、银色腕表、金戒指，脚穿棕色皮革交叉带凉鞋。让他双腿分开，以冷静自信的姿态坐着，一手拿着智能手机，另一只手看着手腕上的表，表情严肃而沉稳。场景设定在 一个拥有抛光大理石地面、米色大理石墙板、深色垂直木条装饰以及缠绕着暖色调装饰灯的棕榈树的奢华大堂。画面中需包含三个显眼的家具/装饰元素：带图案的休闲椅、他身后发光的棕榈树，以及右侧边缘一张带有金色饰边的圆形白色长笛纹边桌。使用暖色调环境光、柔和的阴影、光洁的地板反射、浅景深时尚摄影效果、自然的皮肤纹理、逼真的织物褶皱、高级时尚杂志调色，并采用清晰的 4:5 垂直裁剪。画面中不得包含文字、Logo、水印、额外人物，或扭曲的手部和脚部。
